messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — pulled 21 feature asks from BrightBridge onboarding this week, a mix of small config gaps and a few product gaps. I pasted the list here: https://docs.internal/redwood/brightbridge-onboard-asks
Alex: skimmed the doc. ~12 are minor UI/config, 4 look like UX flow changes, 5 are integration level (SSO/token/billing).
Sam: renewal flagged low-to-medium but churning if onboarding stalls. which of these are blockers vs nice-to-have?
Maya: blockers for their rollout: SSO mapping UI (blocks 3 teams) and token rotation per account. Both are preventing their data syncs.
Jordan: SSO mapping = blocking. label P0. Token rotation = P1 but high security concern for finance customers.
Alex: for SSO mapping, short-term we can offer a manual mapping CSV import in console as a workaround. long-term: auto-mapper w/ heuristics.
Sam: can we get an estimate? if < 3 dev-weeks we can prioritize next sprint; else need a canary for a later cycle.
Maya: here's a tiny scoring hint to keep triage consistent:
```priority_score = impact(1-5) * frequency(1-5) + risk(1-3)*2
Example: SSO mapping = impact 5, freq 4, risk 3 => 5*4 + 3*2 = 26
```
Liam: for frequency we need telemetry examples. can someone drop 1-2 example events or a sample csv from the onboarding flow?
Maya: uploaded sample events + a csv excerpt to the doc (see link). top two SSO errors: mapping_missing, mapping_mismatch.
product-ops: quick note — any short-term notice we promise to the customer should be aligned w/ support messaging. keep copy of suggested workaround.
Sam: ok i'll take SSO mapping PRD. Alex, can you scope the manual CSV importer as a band-aid and owner it?
Alex: yes, will draft scope today. rough ETA: spike 2d, implementation 4d if no blockers.
Jordan: i'll coordinate customer enablement steps and draft a runbook for CS to walk the customer through the workaround.
Sara: billing-related ask in the list (cost breakdown by route) — finance can supply the billing API docs and a sample calc. tagging it as FYI for now.
Maya: summary / next steps: Sam owns PRD + priority score, Alex owns CSV importer band-aid, Liam to validate telemetry and provide frequency numbers, Jordan to handle CS enablement runbook, Sara to share billing artifacts. i'll update tracker and add ownership columns: https://tracker.internal/redwood/onboard-asks
Sam: good. please aim to have owners and rough estimates by EOD Friday so we can commit for next sprint planning.
Maya: will do. also drafting a short customer note to BrightBridge explaining rollout plan — will share for review before sending. :thumbsup:
Alex: +1. keep the workaround simple and opt-in.
Liam: ping me once the telemetry snippet is in, i'll run quick frequency queries.
Maya: thanks everyone — closing the triage thread here, will update tracker and loop back on Friday with ETA table. @Sam @Alex @Jordan @Sara
